source_authority: NCBI GEO and the primary publication

publication.title: Pooled CRISPR screening with single-cell transcriptome read-out

files.name: GSE92872_CROP-seq_Jurkat_TCR.digital_expression.csv.gz
files.role: source cell metadata and digital-expression matrix

files.name: Supplementary Table 2
files.role: complete 116-row TCR gRNA library with 20-nt guide sequences

materialization_policy: Join every accepted OBS row to the ordered GEO digital-expression header after AnnData make_index_unique; map all experimental and control gRNA IDs to Supplementary Table 2; preserve the accepted X/VAR physical members only after exact source-matrix and ordered-axis parity; publish only an append-only OBS successor.
x_semantics_policy: raw_counts is accepted only after every value in the accepted 5905 x 24389 X member equals the corresponding integer, non-negative value in the source digital-expression matrix.

processing_decisions.perturbation_type: CRISPRko because the primary paper describes Cas9 genome editing and knockout signatures; the generic prior CRISPR label is retained as source_original_perturbation_type.
processing_decisions.guide_identity: guide_id is the exact GEO grna header and guide_sequence is the exact Supplementary Table 2 gRNA_ID join, including non-targeting controls.
processing_decisions.condition: stimulated cells received anti-CD3 and anti-CD28 for 4 h; unstimulated cells continued serum starvation for the same interval and are the TCR-condition baseline.
processing_decisions.var: the accepted unique 24389-row ENSG-enriched VAR is retained when its order exactly equals the X feature axis; the extra all-zero or filtered source genes are not rematerialized.
processing_decisions.chunking: one approximately 130 MB X member remains one member because it is already below the target envelope.
